description: Striker's Diadem Level 60 Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of Strife, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
